fields.content:
1. Peanut Butter and Fruit Toast

Toast will always be a classic, but swapping plain butter for strawberry peanut butter makes it feel like something special. Add banana slices or berries and you’ve got a balanced meal with carbs, protein and good fats.

Extra tip: Sprinkle chia or flax seeds on top for extra crunch and a little nutrition boost.
